archive_verification: Original full anonymous object/member readback receipts retained; all 166 published snapshot object sizes/existence and fresh manifest SHA256 verified anonymously on cleanup date.
superseded_manifest_resolution: Original request-appendix manifest has no separate retained receipt; its two payload objects have identical size/SHA256 to the verified permissions-corrected snapshot. Only archive permission descriptors changed.
discarded_material: Redundant public archive downloads and decoded/extracted copies
Duplicate source checkouts, preparation bundles and rebuildable runtimes/caches
Superseded issue drafts, query records, interim scripts and dispatch scratch files
Unredacted private/provider/account working configuration, excluded from public retention
required_evidence_retention: Original task assets, native requests/results, source notices, manifests and conclusions remain on the permanent research branch and reviewed append-only public bucket snapshots.
disk_space_note: Filesystem observations can include concurrent sessions; inode allocation inventory can count hard links more than once.
removal_mode: Rate-limited metadata-only deletion, maximum 1000 unlink/rmdir operations per second, nice 19 and idle I/O; no file-content reads.
